annotations.title: Scrape the reviews on an Amazon product page

description: Returns the review data an Amazon product page shows to a signed-out visitor, as JSON: the overall `rating`, total `reviewCount` (global ratings), the 5..1-star `histogram` (percent per star), the AI `customersSay` summary (overall text plus per-aspect `sentiment`, `mentions`, `positive`, `negative`, `summary` and the quoted review `excerpts` Amazon shows for the aspect) and the top `reviews` (each with `id`, `url`, `author`, `rating`, `title`, `body`, `date`, `country`, `fromOtherCountry`, `verified`, `helpfulVotes`, `variant` and `images`). Identify the product with `asin` (plus `marketplace`) or a product `url`. Scope: Amazon only shows its full review list to signed-in customers, so this endpoint returns the public slice on the product page - typically 5 to 13 top reviews, local ones first and then reviews from other countries - not a complete review export. When Amazon hides the top reviews behind a sign-in prompt (common on amazon.com), `reviewsGated` is `true` and `reviews` is empty; the rating, histogram and customers-say data, including its review excerpts, are still returned. Every field is always present and is `null` when the page does not show it. `proxy_country` defaults to the marketplace's home country; the country of the proxy that served the request is reported as `exitCountry`. Returns JSON. Billed like an API request; listing plugins bill one unit per result page they fetch, so keep max_results modest.

asin.description: Amazon product id (10-char ASIN, e.g. 'B07PXGQC1Q'; books use their ISBN-10). Give either `asin` (with `marketplace`) or a product `url`.

marketplace.description: Regional Amazon site the ASIN belongs to. Reviews are read from that store. One of: amazon.com, amazon.co.uk, amazon.de, amazon.fr, amazon.it, amazon.es, amazon.nl, amazon.se, amazon.pl, amazon.com.be, amazon.com.tr, amazon.ca, amazon.com.mx, amazon.com.br, amazon.co.jp, amazon.in, amazon.ae, amazon.sa, amazon.sg, amazon.com.au. Default: amazon.com.

proxy_country.description: Proxy country the request is sent from (ISO-2, e.g. 'US', 'DE'). Defaults to the marketplace's home country. The reviews come from the marketplace itself, so any proxy country returns the same reviews.

url.description: Full Amazon product url, e.g. 'https://www.amazon.de/dp/B0D1XD1ZV3'. The ASIN and marketplace are read from it, so `asin`/`marketplace` are not needed when a url is given.

name: amazon_reviews
title: Scrape the reviews on an Amazon product page
